description: The well-ordered subset types of A are bounded, their successors lie below its Hartogs bound, and that bound cannot inject into A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.hartogsBound_spec.{u} (α : Type u) :
  BddAbove (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.hartogsTypes α) ∧
    (∀ o ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.hartogsTypes α, o + 1 ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.hartogsBound α) ∧
      ¬Nonempty ((Lemmatheca.SetTheory.hartogsBound α).ToType ↪ α)
